mapper.sql:
select u.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, u.char_id, c.char_no, c.char_nm, u.insp_type, u.proc_id, p.proc_cd, p.proc_nm, case when c.data_type = 'ATTRIBUTE' then 'P' else 'XBAR_R' end as chart_type, u.subgroup_cnt, u.last_at, (select s.limit_id from qms_spc_limit s where s.item_id = u.item_id and s.char_id = u.char_id and s.insp_type = u.insp_type and s.proc_id is not distinct from u.proc_id and s.status = 'ACTIVE') as limit_id, u.item_id || ':' || u.char_id || ':' || u.insp_type || ':' || coalesce(u.proc_id, 0) as unit_key from qms_spc_unit u join mst_item i on i.item_id = u.item_id join qms_char c on c.char_id = u.char_id left join mst_proc p on p.proc_id = u.proc_id
(i.item_cd ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or i.item_nm ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or c.char_no ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or c.char_nm ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\')
mapper.select:
select u.*, case when u.limit_id is null then 'N' else 'Y' end as limit_yn from () u order by
u.item_cd u.insp_type u.subgroup_cnt u.last_at
desc,
u.item_id, u.char_id, u.insp_type, u.proc_id nulls first limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}

select x.insp_line_id, h.insp_id, h.insp_no, l.lot_no, x.lsl, x.usl, min(m.occurred_at) as first_at from qms_insp h join qms_insp_line x on x.insp_id = h.insp_id and x.char_id = #{charId} and x.data_type = 'VARIABLE' join lot_master l on l.lot_id = h.lot_id join qms_insp_meas m on m.insp_line_id = x.insp_line_id and m.void_of_id is null and m.value is not null and not exists (select 1 from qms_insp_meas v where v.void_of_id = m.meas_id) where h.item_id = #{itemId} and h.insp_type = #{inspType} and h.status = 'JUDGED' and h.proc_id is not distinct from #{procId}::bigint group by x.insp_line_id, h.insp_id, h.insp_no, l.lot_no, x.lsl, x.usl having min(m.occurred_at) < #{to} order by min(m.occurred_at) desc, x.insp_line_id desc limit #{limit}

select x.insp_line_id, h.insp_id, h.insp_no, l.lot_no, min(m.occurred_at) as first_at, count(*)::integer as n, (count(*) filter (where m.ok_yn = 'N'))::integer as d from qms_insp h join qms_insp_line x on x.insp_id = h.insp_id and x.char_id = #{charId} and x.data_type = 'ATTRIBUTE' join lot_master l on l.lot_id = h.lot_id join qms_insp_meas m on m.insp_line_id = x.insp_line_id and m.void_of_id is null and m.ok_yn is not null and not exists (select 1 from qms_insp_meas v where v.void_of_id = m.meas_id) where h.item_id = #{itemId} and h.insp_type = #{inspType} and h.status = 'JUDGED' and h.proc_id is not distinct from #{procId}::bigint group by x.insp_line_id, h.insp_id, h.insp_no, l.lot_no having min(m.occurred_at) < #{to} order by min(m.occurred_at) desc, x.insp_line_id desc limit #{limit}

select m.insp_line_id, m.value from qms_insp_meas m where m.insp_line_id in #{id} and m.void_of_id is null and m.value is not null and not exists (select 1 from qms_insp_meas v where v.void_of_id = m.meas_id) order by m.insp_line_id, m.sample_no

mapper.select: select from qms_spc_limit where item_id = #{itemId} and char_id = #{charId} and insp_type = #{inspType} and proc_id is not distinct from #{procId}::bigint and status = 'ACTIVE'

select from qms_spc_limit where item_id = #{itemId} and char_id = #{charId} and insp_type = #{inspType} and proc_id is not distinct from #{procId}::bigint order by created_at desc, limit_id desc limit 50

insert into qms_spc_limit (comp_cd, item_id, char_id, insp_type, proc_id, center, sigma, subgroup_cnt, from_at, to_at, rules, chart_type, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{itemId}, #{charId}, #{inspType}, #{procId}, #{center}, #{sigma}, #{subgroupCnt}, #{fromAt}, #{toAt}, #{rules}, #{chartType}, #{remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning limit_id
